We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: theft of electric bike (value 2300) by Lei? Actually defendant: 令狐某某 stole the bike, then gave to 蒋某某 who bought it for 600, knowing it's stolen. So crimes: 盗窃 (theft) for 令狐某某. Also for 蒋某某: 掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪 (concealing/receiving stolen property). In Chinese criminal law, the term is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪". So answer should list both: 盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得. Format: [罪名]盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得<eoa>.
